criterion: M3 lighting (dated addition 7, 2026-10-10): the record of every run against evidence/m3-lighting-bounds.json, failures included
written: 2026-10-10, after the runs, in the order they happened

runs.result: units exact; IBL furnace 1.1e-15; clusters FAILED (19 lights missing from their cluster lists over 65,536 points, shading off by 3.6%); split sum FAILED (median 0.021, p95 0.401)
runs.cause: clusters: every miss came from the 128-light cap per cluster (12 entries cut where many lights met near the camera). Split sum: the mirror direction, on rough metals with near-horizontal normals
runs.fix: the cap is 256, the clustered path's per-scene light limit, so a list holds every light (0 misses, 0 cut, clustered shading identical to brute force); the lookup direction moved to the Frostbite dominant-direction fit (Lagarde and de Rousiers 2014): p95 0.181

runs.what: first material gallery (a showcase, not a check)
runs.result: hard seams on the roughest gold spheres
runs.cause: levels 4 and 5 of the 32-texel cube had 2 and 1 texels a face, and the sampler clamped at face edges
runs.fix: levels stop at 8 texels a face. The split-sum p95 then read 0.209, outside its bound: the 1-texel faces had happened to average some of the split sum's error away
the lookup direction is now the centroid of the BRDF's own lobe, tabulated from the model by VNDF sampling (pbr::Tables::Dom), replacing the fitted formula; p95 0.171, median 0.016

runs.what: GPU lighting parity on SwiftShader, after the 8-texel floor
runs.cause: in-shader sin and cos of the sample directions carry about 1e-6 error on SwiftShader, and the sun's 1e5 nits amplified it
runs.fix: the prefilter's half-vector samples are computed on the host in double and uploaded

runs.what: second material gallery, GPU against the reference
runs.cause: the dominant direction landed on a cube face seam; float32 and float64 chose different faces, and clamped sampling is discontinuous there
runs.fix: seamless sampling: a bilinear tap past a face edge goes through its texel-centre direction to the neighbouring face, on the CPU and in both WGSL samplers. Prefilter parity went from 0.08 to 0.003 of its bound; split sum p95 0.169

runs.result: CPU: units exact, IBL furnace 1.3e-15, split sum median 0.016 and p95 0.169 over 1,952 samples (reference noise at most 0.019), clusters 0 misses over 55,270 in-frustum points of 65,536 drawn. D3D12 WARP: cluster lists identical off the boundary (1 boundary case), prefilter 0.003, shading 0.587 of the bound. WebGPU SwiftShader: identical off the boundary (2 boundary cases), prefilter 0.003, shading 0.49. Controls fail at 1,074x (prefilter) and 499x (shading).

runs.what: material gallery, 512 px, 4 samples a pixel, GPU (WARP) against the float64 reference (informative, no bound)
runs.result: RMSE 5.6e-5 and worst 0.029 in exposed units; the worst samples sit at near-mirror roughness on the sun's edge, where the environment's gradient is largest

does_not_prove: Anything under does_not_prove in the bounds file. The 65,536 points of the cluster check were drawn, of which 55,270 fell inside the frustum and were checked.
